subject: General Knowledge
description: Missiles, fighter jets, ISRO missions, key institutions

questions.explanation: ISRO — founded 15 August 1969 by Dr. Vikram Sarabhai. HQ: Bengaluru. Under DoS, reports to PM. DRDO — Defence Research and Development Org; HAL — Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd; BARC — Bhabha Atomic Research Centre. Indian Space Research Organisation.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.explanation: Mangalyaan / MOM — launched 5 November 2013 by PSLV-C25 from Sriharikota. Entered Mars orbit on 24 September 2014 — first Asian and first country to succeed ON THE FIRST ATTEMPT. Budget ~₹450 cr, making it one of the cheapest Mars missions ever.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: India became the FIRST country to soft-land on the MOON's SOUTH POLE with:
questions.explanation: Chandrayaan-3 — Vikram lander soft-landed 23 August 2023 near the lunar south pole, making India the 4th country to soft-land on the Moon and the FIRST to reach the south-pole region. 23 August now observed as 'National Space Day' in India.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Match the MISSILE with its CATEGORY. A. Agni-V.  B. BrahMos.  C. Akash.  D. Prithvi. List-II: 1. ICBM / long-range ballistic.  2. Supersonic cruise missile.  3. Surface-to-air missile.  4. Short-range surface-to-surface ballistic.
questions.explanation: Agni-V — range > 5,000 km, India's long-range ICBM-class. BrahMos — supersonic cruise missile (Indo-Russian joint venture). Akash — medium-range SAM (surface-to-air). Prithvi — short-range surface-to-surface ballistic (150-350 km). DRDO-developed.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.explanation: HAL Tejas LCA — designed by ADA, manufactured by HAL. Entered service 2016. Variants: Tejas Mk1, Mk1A. Sukhoi Su-30MKI is Russian-designed, licence-built by HAL. Rafale is French (Dassault). Mirage-2000 — French, entered Indian service in 1985. Light Combat Aircraft.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.explanation: Aryabhata — launched 19 April 1975 by a Soviet Kosmos-3M rocket from Kapustin Yar. Named after the Indian mathematician-astronomer. Bhaskara (1979) was next. SLV-3 launched India's first indigenously-launched satellite (Rohini) in 1980.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: 'Operation Sindoor' and 'Parakram' were Indian military operations primarily associated with:

options.option_text: Major military mobilisations along the western border

questions.explanation: Parakram — full mobilisation along the Pakistan border following the 13 December 2001 Parliament attack. Operation Sindoor — 2025 airstrike / cross-border strike retaliation. (Other major operations: Meghdoot — 1984 Siachen capture; Vijay — Kargil 1999; Blue Star — 1984 Golden Temple; Safed Sagar — 1999 Kargil air operation.)
